title: Group wrap: materialize member_pubkeys before empty check (empty generator yields 0-member envelope)
description: Robustness review finding on worker6-9mkj.2. group_oscore_wrap.py:191: if not member_pubkeys does not catch an empty generator - probe-confirmed a 0-member envelope with no error. A rekey distributed to nobody is silent and group-wide. Fix: member_pubkeys = list(member_pubkeys) before the emptiness check (also gives stable iteration for duplicate detection).
